name: Mail Collection Reminder
subject: Mails Collection ("please fill in")
body:
[[img:86bec4b366e3408e8217f2f18f257fce]]

Dear Client,



We've received mails that are sent to you / your company.



You can come by for collection of your mails during office hours

from 10.00 am to 5:30 pm between Monday to Friday.





If you are unable make a trip to our office to collect your mails, we offer the following services:



1. Scanning services (by mth via email to them)



a) $30 per mth (min12 mths subscription)



or



b) S$50 per scan if no subscription (below 100 pages per scan)

*additional scan $10 per 20 pages



Please make the payment to <eric.eio@php-cpa.com.sg> via PayPal and reply to

this email with a print screen of your transaction so that we can proceed to render the service.



Terms of Service

The following procedures shall apply to any mail or unregistered letter:



Mails not collected within 6 months since notification will be discharged
Paul Hype Page & Co will not be responsible for any misplaced or lost mail




If you have a request to make regarding mail collection, please contact and discuss with us.
